Description: TLS 1.0 is still accepted by the web server.
Solution: Disable TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1; require TLS 1.2 or higher.

Description: The administrative panel accepts the vendor default username and password.
Solution: Change the default credentials and enforce a strong password policy.

Description: Stack traces are returned to the client on unhandled exceptions.
Solution: Disable debug mode in production and return generic error pages.

Vulnerability: Missing HttpOnly flag on session cookie
Description: The session cookie is not marked HttpOnly.
Solution: Set the HttpOnly and Secure flags on all session cookies.

Description: The site bundles a jQuery version with known historical advisories not applicable to this deployment.
Solution: Upgrade to the latest jQuery release during the next maintenance window.
